title: Worker view pointer small sort
summary: At 0x42c920, sort a half-open pointer range by the signed 32-bit field at offset 0x188 using stable insertion. The internal optimized ABI receives first in ECX and last in EDX; the caller at 0x42c310 dispatches ranges of at most 32 elements. The portable implementation uses a normal C++ function and preserves the observable array and object behavior.
test_description: Freestanding i386 tests enumerate lengths zero through seven and four signed key values, verify stable order, full array canaries and unchanged object bytes against an independent ranking, and compare directly to the original whenever no element is below the first key. Extreme signed keys and empty null range are also checked. FS setup and restoration are checked for every original call. Prepend cases are checked against expected results without calling the original.
known_limits: The original prepend branch calls memmove via IAT 0x92d4a4, for which no trusted binding is supplied; that branch is not directly oracle-tested.
Only valid forward ranges of non-null pointers to objects containing the key are modeled; invalid ranges and pointers have no defined portable behavior.
The surrounding object and the semantic meaning of the key are unresolved. No byte matching is claimed.
